bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance, degradation, and capabilities across diverse linguistic inputs and dialects (e.g., African American English vs. White Mainstream English) using specific benchmark datasets like Multi-VALUE, VALUE, and CORAAL.

Assessing models using group-specific evaluation metrics (like demographic parity), probing datasets with fill-in-the-blank templates to measure stereotype generation, and utilizing reference benchmarks such as WinoBias and WinoGender.

Measuring equal opportunity and demographic parity in model predictions, auditing image generation outputs for diverse skin-tone representation, and employing stereotype benchmarks like StereoSet and CrowS-Pairs.

Auditing training datasets for the disproportionate filtering of LGBTQ+ identity terms, and evaluating generated content (such as images of families) to detect the reproduction of heteronormative stereotypes or exclusionary norms.
